question: Where does the user currently work?
answer: At Globex, where they moved after leaving Initech.

haystack_sessions.content: I just started a new role at Initech as a backend engineer. The team seems great.
Congratulations on the new role at Initech.
Work has been hectic but I am enjoying the backend systems we are building.
Glad to hear it is going well.
Big news: I left Initech and now work at Globex. The commute is shorter and the pay is better.
That is exciting. Congratulations on the move to Globex.
